metadata.title: Why Wartime Liberty Ships Cracked in Half
metadata.description:
Liberty ships cracked and some broke in two. The cause: brittle fracture in welded hulls, starting at sharp corners and weld defects.

Failure chain: Hulls welded for speed → Steel brittle in cold water → Cracks start at square corners → Crack runs through welded plates → Hull splits

Related episode: How Daniel J. Morrell Really Failed — https://youtu.be/6Xsisq9PrHo
